response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.healtheval AS status, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_ratio > m.mean_avg ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
